entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and the order number, please?

Thank you, Mark. Pulling that up now... I see the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 15th. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a preference. I just don't like it.
I understand. Could you tell me a little more about what you didn't like? Perhaps I can help you with a feature you might have missed.
Look, it's just really hard to use. The whole menu system is confusing, and I honestly expected more for the price.
I'm sorry to hear that it wasn't intuitive for you. Did you get a chance to look at the quick start section of the user manual? It often clarifies the main functions.
I read the user manual. It didn't help. I just want to send it back.

Okay, no problem at all, Mark. Let me just confirm the return eligibility. One moment... Okay, I see the delivery was 39 days ago. And our policy states that you have 10 days for a return. So, you are unfortunately outside the window. I can process this for you right now.

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
And since I see you're a VIP member with us, and for the trouble you've had, I've also gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account. You can use that on any future purchase.
Whatever. I guess that's something. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, Mark. Have a good day.
